commonNames.name: Coquerel's Giant Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Coquerel's giant mouse lemur (Mirza coquereli), also known as Coquerel's dwarf lemur or the southern giant mouse lemur, is a small nocturnal lemur endemic to Madagascar. This species can be found in parts of the Madagascar dry deciduous forests.
wikipedia.title: Coquerel's giant mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Crinifer is a genus of birds in the turaco family. They are restricted to Africa.
wikipedia.title: Crinifer

wikipedia.extract: Carpococcyx is a genus of large, terrestrial cuckoos in the family Cuculidae. They are restricted to humid forested regions in Southeast Asia.
wikipedia.title: Carpococcyx

wikipedia.extract: The blue whale (Balaenoptera musculus) is a species of baleen whale and the largest marine mammal in the rorqual family Balaenopteridae. Reaching a maximum confirmed length of 29.9–30.5 m (98–100 ft) and weighing up to 190–200 t (190–200 long tons; 210–220 short tons), it is the largest animal known to have ever existed.
wikipedia.title: Blue whale

wikipedia.extract: Geoffroy's tamarin (Saguinus geoffroyi), also known as the Panamanian, red-crested or rufous-naped tamarin, is a tamarin, a type of small monkey, found in Panama and Colombia. It is predominantly black and white, with a reddish nape.
wikipedia.title: Geoffroy's tamarin

wikipedia.extract: The crested eagle (Morphnus guianensis) is a large neotropical eagle, the only member of the genus Morphnus. The crested eagle can grow up to 89 cm (35 in) long, with a wingspan up to 176 cm (69 in), and weigh up to 3 kg (6.6 lb).
wikipedia.title: Crested eagle

wikipedia.extract: Pipreola is a genus of bird in the family Cotingidae. Together with Ampelioides tschudii, they are collectively known as fruiteaters.
wikipedia.title: Pipreola

commonNames.name: Danfoss' Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus danfossi Olivieri, Zimmermann, Randrianambinina, Rassoloharijaona, Rakotondravony, Gsuchanski et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: Danfoss's mouse lemur (Microcebus danfossi), or the Ambarijeby mouse lemur, is a species of mouse lemur endemic to Madagascar. It lives in western deciduous forest within a limited range between the Sofia River and the Maevarano River.
wikipedia.title: Danfoss's mouse lemur

commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

commonNames.name: Bolivian Red Howler Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Bolivian red howler (Alouatta sara) is a species of howler monkey, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Bolivia. It can be found in rain forests, including riverine and seasonally flooded forests.
wikipedia.title: Bolivian red howler

wikipedia.extract: The anis are the three species of birds in the genus Crotophaga of the cuckoo family. They are essentially tropical New World birds, although the range of two species just reaches the United States.
wikipedia.title: Ani (bird)

commonNames.name: Anosy Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus tanosi Rasoloarison, Weisrock, Yoder, Rakotondravony & Kappeler, 2013

wikipedia.extract: The Anosy mouse lemur (Microcebus tanosi) is a species of mouse lemur known only from the Manantantely Forest and Ivorona Forest in southeastern Madagascar, near Tôlanaro. Specimens were first collected in April 2007, and its discovery was announced in 2013 along with the Marohita mouse lemur (Microcebus marohita).
wikipedia.title: Anosy mouse lemur

wikipedia.extract: Allochrocebus is a primate genus including the terrestrial guenons: the L'Hoest's monkey, the Preuss's monkey, and the sun-tailed monkey.
wikipedia.title: Allochrocebus
